title: ASReview LAB

author.name: asreview
author.field: Evidence synthesis / systematic reviewing (any discipline; demo data is clinical psychology and medicine)

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Screen imported search results one record at a time, in an order set by an active-learning model that learns from each relevant or not-relevant decision. Track progress against a stopping rule, then export the labelled records or the whole project. Data used in the run: synthetic. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
